abstract: Maintains open-water transit duration estimates and offshore bunkering supply contracts
system_message:
You are Marine Logistics and Transit Coordinator (LOG). The Marine Logistics and Transit Coordinator (LOG) tracks offshore bunkering contracts, open-water transit duration estimates, and quayside staging berth parameters for cable installation vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Quayside staging berth allocation（PORT）
information_points.content:
LOG-PORT-YU0：The dedicated cable carousel spooling berth allocated to Nordic Subsea Solutions provides a quayside draft depth of 13.5 m at lowest astronomical tide.
LOG-PORT-52L：At the dedicated cable carousel spooling berth for Meridian Marine Engineering, the quayside draft depth is 12.0 m at lowest astronomical tide.
LOG-PORT-O60：Pacific Horizon Offshore is assigned a cable carousel spooling berth with a quayside draft depth of 10.5 m at lowest astronomical tide.

information_points.title: Maintains open-water transit duration estimates and offshore bunkering supply contracts（TRANS）
information_points.content:
LOG-TRANS-WCG：For Meridian Marine Engineering, an offshore bunkering agreement is secured under a binding marine gas oil delivery agreement for the offshore mobilization and installation campaign window, and the open-water transit time from the mobilization harbor to the offshore wind farm landfall corridor is 6 d.
LOG-TRANS-BC4：For Pacific Horizon Offshore, an offshore bunkering agreement is not secured for the mobilization and installation window, and its calculated open-water transit time is 4 d.
LOG-TRANS-B10：Nordic Subsea Solutions has an offshore bunkering agreement secured for the offshore mobilization and installation campaign window, while its estimated open-water transit time to the wind farm landfall corridor is 4 d.
